verdict.rationale: Convex gives each project a separate dev deployment: `convex dev` pushes changes there and `npx convex run` executes functions against it. It also documents running a deployment locally and lists preview deployments on its plans. For agents specifically, the MCP server cannot access production deployments by default, as a stated safety measure against accidental changes to production data. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of data isolation and seeding for dev/preview deployments (preview deployments appear only as a pricing-page bullet), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
